title: Complete Active Care Anti-Dandruff Nourishing Shampoo

details.description: Clear Complete Active Care Anti-Dandruff Nourishing Shampoo with zinc pyrithione and climbazole fights dandruff and nourishes the scalp for healthier-looking hair.
details.usageInstructions: 1. Apply it to your wet hair and massage into the scalp. 2. Once applied, rinse thoroughly. 3. For best results repeat the process and use every day.
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes; if it happens, rinse well with water. Keep out of reach of children.

title: Active Care Anti-Dandruff Nourishing Hair Oil

details.description: Clear Active Care Anti-Dandruff Hair Oil with vitamin E and 2% sunflower oil is a lightweight, non-sticky oil that nourishes from root to tip, reduces dryness and dandruff irritation and restores shine.
details.ingredients:
Mineral Oil, Isopropyl Myristate, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Perfume, Mentha Arvensis (Peppermint) Oil, Piroctone Olamine, BHT, Tocopheryl Acetate.
Contains 94.4% Mineral Oil (w/w) and 2% Sunflower Oil (w/w).
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes; if it happens, rinse well with water. Keep out of reach of children.
details.usageInstructions: Massage the oil into the hair from the roots, leave on the scalp for at least an hour, then rinse with Clear Complete Active Care shampoo.
